name: Build a Store🏪
desc:
🌟 Welcome to Build a Store! 🏪

⭐ CONTENT UPDATE! ⭐

- Tons of new products
- Selection of new decorations
- Spin Wheel + Free daily spin

+ Stock chance adjustments!

🛠️ HOW TO PLAY:

🛒 Buy Products & place them in your store.
💵 Sell to Customers to earn money.
🏗️ Expand Your Store to fit more shelves and products.
💎 Unlock Rarer Products to boost your profits!
⏰ Your stock sells even while you’re offline! Come back the next day to restock and grow your business!

Like & Favorite the game for more Updates!
